About Us

TGW Group is one of the leading construction and infrastructure groups in Israel, and operates through its subsidiaries that create diverse and maximum value for its shareholders in Israel and around the world. The TGW Group operates in a number of main areas: industry (recycling and production of raw materials for the building and infrastructure industry), building contracting, infrastructure contracting, development, operation and maintenance of buildings, factories, sewage treatment plants, landscaping and restoration, renewable energy and international activity. From the founding of the group until today, it has established through the various divisions and subsidiaries hundreds of thousands of meters of construction, many infrastructure and development projects, parks, and diverse factories.

Establishing international presence
The company extended its presence into three countries since foundation: Israel, Chile and Belarus and plans to continue expanding into three new countries in the near future: Greece, Cyprus, and Finland

Growing our shareholder value
The integration of the company's capabilities in developing, planning, constructing, procuring, financing, operating and maintenance, enables it to promote projects throughout the value chain while increasing the total shareholder returns

Advancing new Technologies
The technologies in all renewable energy areas the company operates is rapidly innovating and improving. We use the most advanced components in our projects to ensure longevity, reliability, efficiency and lowest costs
